title: Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Salesforce Technical Architecture
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Technology Architect, a typical day involves designing and delivering comprehensive technology architecture tailored for a specific platform, product, or engagement. This role requires defining solutions that address critical aspects such as performance, capability, and scalability. The professional collaborates closely with various stakeholders to ensure that the architectural vision aligns with business goals and technical requirements, continuously refining and adapting the architecture to meet evolving needs and challenges within the project environment.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead architectural reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and standards.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to align objectives.
* Mentor junior team members to foster professional growth and knowledge sharing.
* Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and recommending their adoption where appropriate.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Salesforce Technical Architecture.
* Experience in designing scalable and high\-performance solutions within Salesforce environments.
* Strong knowledge of integration patterns and middleware technologies related to Salesforce.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical designs.
* Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and platform services relevant to Salesforce architecture.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in Salesforce Technical Architecture.
* This position is based at our AMDC1A \- NON\-STPI location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - Observability Preferred
description:
**Role \- Senior Golang Engineer \- Observability Preferred** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable
 



 working close to the machine in Go/Rust, and equally comfortable reasoning about distributed behavior
 



 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.
 



 • Normalize collected data into a common internal model, applying OpenTelemetry semantic
 



 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.
 



 • Build the data substrate for anomaly and signal detection — streaming aggregation, rollingwindow state, baselining, and correlation across metrics, logs, and traces — and integrate
 



 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.
 



 • Write clean, testable, well\-instrumented code, participate in code reviews, and contribute
 



 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




  





**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT
 



 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on backend engineering, with production\-level proficiency in Go and the
 



 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).
 



 • Strong debugging and production problem\-solving ability using profilers, tracing, logs, and metrics.
 



 • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or similar observability infrastructure.
 



 • Strong reasoning and first\-principles problem\-solving — the ability to break down an unfamiliar
 



 problem, form a hypothesis, and test it, rather than pattern\-matching to a previous solution.
 



 • Adaptive mindset — comfortable with changing priorities, evolving requirements, and switching
 



 between languages, platforms, and modules.
 



 • AI\-ready working style — treats AI tooling as leverage, prompts and reviews critically, and
 



 understands where generated code needs to be challenged.
 



 • A strong reading and self\-learning habit — follows source code, specifications, and engineering
 



 blogs, and can bring what they read back into the product.
 



 • Working comfort with statistical concepts as applied to time\-series (distributions, seasonality,
 



 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.
 



 • Ownership and accountability — takes a module from design through production support, raises
 



 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

title: SR.Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ascenten Technologies delivers end\-to\-end embedded electronics and product engineering solutions for enterprises, OEMs, and technology\-driven organizations building next\-generation connected products. The company’s multidisciplinary expertise spans embedded systems, hardware engineering, firmware development, IoT, industrial automation, smart metering, medical electronics, fire and safety, automotive, and telecom technologies. Ascenten partners with global customers to accelerate product innovation and optimize engineering execution. The focus is on delivering scalable, production\-ready solutions designed for long\-term reliability, giving engineers exposure to complex, real\-world applications and cutting\-edge technologies.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Sr. Embedded Firmware Engineer role is based in Ahmedabad and focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining embedded firmware for connected electronic products. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include architecting firmware solutions, implementing and testing embedded software on ARM\-based platforms, and collaborating with hardware and electrical engineering teams to ensure seamless system integration. The role involves debugging complex system\-level issues, optimizing performance and memory usage, and contributing to design reviews and documentation. The engineer needs to be self driven and motivated to take ownerships of tasks and deliver results independently, while mentoring junior team members and coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong embedded software development skills, including experience with C/C\+\+ and real\-time operating systems on microcontrollers and microprocessors.
* Hands\-on expertise in debugging and troubleshooting embedded systems using tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers.
* Proficiency working with ARM architecture, including low\-level driver development, peripheral configuration, and performance optimization.
* Solid foundation in electrical engineering concepts, with the ability to interpret schematics and collaborate effectively with hardware design teams.
* Experience with end\-to\-end firmware lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, coding, unit testing, integration, and maintenance.
* Familiarity with communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet), IoT stacks, and industrial or automotive standards is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with version control systems (e.g., Git), build systems, and structured documentation practices.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with several years of experience in embedded firmware development.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, and communicate clearly in a professional, gender\-neutral, and inclusive manner.

By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Interiors Finishes is responsible for leading Adani Airports’ interior design programs for Terminal buildings, cityside development (CSD) projects and ATC Complexes. With a focus on design management from concept to as\-built stages, this role ensures that all interior projects align with the airport's long\-term development vision. The role requires extensive experience in large\-scale airport infrastructure, particularly in terminals, to deliver high\-quality, innovative, and sustainable design solutions that enhance passenger experience and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Purpose**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
 The Lead Design Interiors will be an Architect responsible for driving interior design initiatives for real estate and hospitality projects. The role demands expertise in approvals, conceptualization, and execution of mixed\-use developments, business parks, and retail spaces.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee interior \& architectural design for hospitality\-led mixed\-use developments, business parks, and retail spaces
* Prepare and issue RFPs for design consultants and vendors
* Review GFC drawings for accuracy and completeness
* Drive value engineering initiatives
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for successful execution
* Implement and manage BIM processes for design coordination
* Ensure adherence to brand standards and sustainability principles
* Mentor junior architects and foster a high\-performing team
* Conduct site visits and participate in project meetings
* Continuously improve design processes and methodologies


**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor of Architecture (mandatory)
* Preferred: Master of Architecture from reputed institutes (e.g., CEPT University, SPA)


**Experience**
* 15–18 years in architectural design for real estate and hospitality projects
* Proven track record of leading full\-cycle projects from concept to completion


**Certifications**
 No mandatory certifications; relevant design certifications are advantageous
   

  

**Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp
* Strong understanding of building materials, construction techniques, and sustainable design
* Expertise in hospitality\-led architectural concepts


**Behavioral Skills**
* Exceptional leadership and communication
* Strong problem\-solving and attention to detail
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, deadline\-driven environment


**Non\-Negotiable Skills**
* Interiors \& Architectural Design for hospitality\-led mixed\-use development
* Experience in business parks and retail design
* At least one full cycle from concept development to on\-site completion


**Conclusion**
 This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead transformative design initiatives at Adani. If you are passionate about innovative and sustainable architectural solutions and meet the above criteria, we encourage you to apply.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Build, configure, and test data center and AI infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, and platform layers. Translate architectural designs into scalable, secure, and high\-performance production environments through reliable implementation and automation.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 AWS Administration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Infrastructure Engineer, your typical day involves constructing, setting up, and validating data center and artificial intelligence infrastructure that spans computing, storage, networking, and platform components. You will transform architectural blueprints into scalable, secure, and efficient production systems by ensuring dependable deployment and automation. This role requires a hands\-on approach to managing complex infrastructure environments to support organizational needs effectively and reliably.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure infrastructure aligns with project requirements and organizational goals.
* Monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to maintain high availability and reliability.
* Document infrastructure configurations and processes to support knowledge sharing and operational continuity.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS Administration.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure components including compute, storage, and networking services.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure automation and orchestration tools to streamline deployment processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in a timely manner.
* Familiarity with security best practices and compliance requirements in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of performance tuning and capacity planning to ensure optimal infrastructure utilization.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in AWS Administration.
* This position is based at our AMDC1A \- NON\-STPI location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.
